_readme: What the buttons on the display do. The display only sends the button number; this file decides the meaning. You can edit it without reflashing - the API re-reads it on every press.
_labels: Leave 'label' out to get the name from langlib.ps1 via 'labelKey', so the buttons follow your Windows display language. Set an explicit 'label' to override that with your own text.

1._readme: Brings the window to the front and confirms the highlighted choice. Only works when that session is genuinely asking for attention.

4._readme: Button 4 is the CYD's own BOOT button; you can use it freely while it is running. Holding it for two seconds opens the cracktro instead.

_types.focus: bring the session's window to the front
_types.keys: bring the window forward and send keys (SendKeys: {ENTER} {ESC} {TAB} ^c y~ ...)
_types.snooze: silence a session for 'minutes' minutes: no orange, no beep
_types.run: start a program or command, field 'command' (plus optional 'args'); {cwd} is replaced by the session's folder
_types.open: open a folder, file or url, field 'path' ({cwd} allowed)
